content:
Let \(x\) be the number of angles less than \(150^\circ\). The sum of all angles is  
\[
(2017-2)180^\circ=362700^\circ.
\]
For \(x\) such angles, the total sum is maximized when those \(x\) angles are just below \(150^\circ\) and the remaining \(2017-x\) angles are just below \(180^\circ\). Thus the total is strictly less than
\[
150x+180(2017-x)=363060-30x.
\]
So we need
\[
362700<363060-30x,
\]
which gives
\[
30x<360 \implies x<12.
\]
Hence at most \(11\) angles can be less than \(150^\circ\). This is attainable by taking \(11\) angles just below \(150^\circ\) and the remaining \(2006\) angles just below \(180^\circ\).

\[
\boxed{11}
\]
